info.title: dotprof
info.description: Profiling tool for .NET in AI era.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: dotprof/1.2.0 - Inject trace logs to methods, properties and constructors.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework moniker (e.g., net10.0, netstandard2.1)

options.name: --path
options.description: Project folder, .csproj, or .dll file path (Defaults to '.')

options.name: --logger
options.description: Custom logger method name (e.g., UnityEngine.Debug.Log)

options.name: --targets
options.description: Comma-separated target names (Omit to target all methods)

options.name: --exclude-paths
options.description: Boundary-aware, case-insensitive match (Defaults to Test,Tests)

options.name: --full-names
options.description: Injects fully qualified name to log messages

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show dotnet command and debug logs

options.name: --version
options.description:
Run Mode:
Injects trace hooks and executes resulting .dll with arguments.
ex) dnx -y dotprof -- --verbose - baz qux
--> dotnet <main.dll> bar quz  # Last built file is <main.dll>
Test Mode:
Injects trace hooks and then run test.
ex) dnx -y dotprof -- test -p ./Foo - --filter Name~Foo
--> dotprof -p ./Foo
--> dotnet test --filter Name~Foo
